source.title: Department of Veterans Affairs section (Table-5 cap-fit unit, page 18). Full 9-column outlays model. Reclassified from over-cap to cap-fit by the 2026-07-15 sizing pass (139 cells; the raised <=140 single-unit ceiling). NESTED (family 3): Benefits Programs rolls its member lines (Public Enterprise Funds Housing Accounts/Other, Compensation and Pensions, Readjustment Benefits, Veterans Housing Benefit Program Fund, Insurance Funds National Service Life/Veterans Special Life, Other) into Total--Benefits Programs, which then feeds the department roll-up. Public Enterprise Funds and Insurance Funds are visual sub-groups with NO printed subtotal; Veterans Health Administration and Departmental Administration likewise have no printed subtotal (their lines feed the department total directly). Family pattern: plans/treasury-mts-2026-05-outlays-table5.md; worked examples: -state (nesting), -homeland-security.
source.period: May FY2026 (This Month = May 2026; Current FYTD = Oct 2025 - May 2026; Prior FYTD = Oct 2024 - May 2025)

unit_note: USD millions ('[$ millions]' per table header). Table 5 legend (p. 23): '......' = 'No Transactions' (omitted); '(**)' = 'Less than absolute value of $500,000' (omitted). Many '(**)' omissions in this section: the all-'(**)' 'Veterans Choice Fund, Veterans Health Administration' row is dropped entirely; 'Housing Accounts' survives only at Prior-FYTD Applicable (2) / Outlays (-2); 'General Operating Expenses' only at Current-FYTD Applicable (1) / Outlays (-1); 'Veterans Housing Benefit Program Fund' and 'Veterans Special Life' and 'Proprietary Receipts / National Service Life' each omit specific '(**)' applicable cells. Values as printed, thousands separators stripped, negatives as leading '-'. Nine-column model: 3 periods x (Gross Outlays / Applicable Receipts / Outlays[net]). Every Applicable column has >=2 sources at both the Benefits Programs and department level, so all columns roll up and no standalone is needed. Per-line net identities are declared on the four lines that print gross+applicable+net for a period (VHA Other, Public Enterprise Funds Other, Veterans Special Life, Benefits Programs Other). Non-default tolerances quote the Table-5 rounding note (p. 23): 'Note: Details may not add to totals due to rounding.' All observed gaps are <=2 (department This-Month net roll-up off by 2 across ~11 rounded sources); all values are render-verified against the page-18 render (both bands).
